trust_decision.summary: Whether an API user with plain read/write/approve rights may act on a leave request or expense report of a user outside their hierarchy (not self or subordinate, no readall). checkUserAccessToObject decides this, but runs the hierarchy test only when given the full object. The REST APIs passed only the ID, so the test was skipped.

landing_point.why: The summary names the Leave Request REST API. Holidays::get is the first object-level check in that class.

fix_sites.module_kind: REST API handler, expensereport module (not named in advisory)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: htdocs/expensereport/class/api_expensereports.class.php:109 (13 sites). This is a second module's REST API under the same hierarchy rule (htdocs/core/lib/security.lib.php:1260-1266). The advisory names only the Leave Request API.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about the Leave Request API, so a solver could treat expense reports as a separate module with its own advisory. Also, ExpenseReports::index needs only 'lire', not 'readall' as Holidays::index does, which a solver could read as intended for list views.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The leave validator (fk_validator) must keep access to a leave whose owner is outside their hierarchy, and readall holders must keep access to all records. A fix that checks only owner-in-childids, or that requires readall, breaks approve/refuse by the assigned validator and self-service for normal employees.

O6_input_shapes: Full object passed instead of a numeric ID (the hierarchy branch requires is_object, htdocs/core/lib/security.lib.php:1251)
Comma-separated ID list accepted by checkUserAccessToObject (htdocs/core/lib/security.lib.php:981), but this ID-only path still skips the hierarchy check after the fix

O7_producer.where: Hierarchy data comes from User::getAllChildIds, called directly by the check at htdocs/core/lib/security.lib.php:1252

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /expensereports list returns every expense report in the entity to any user with 'lire', with no hierarchy filter. Holidays::index requires readall.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: List endpoint, not a per-object check. The fix pattern (pass the object) does not apply, and the user_ids filter looks like a deliberate feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as 13 fix sites; needs an SQL filter on childids (a different mechanism)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /expensereports and POST /holidays accept the target-user field (fk_user_author / fk_user) from the request body with no hierarchy check. The web create path enforces one.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Create has no existing object to check, and the advisory is about access to existing leave requests.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same files as fix; web counterparts at htdocs/expensereport/card.php:286-298 and htdocs/holiday/card.php:211-220

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Expense report payment endpoints (GET /payments, GET /payments/{pid}, POST {id}/payments, PUT {id}/payments) check only the module right and never check the parent report's hierarchy.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Payments are a separate object (PaymentExpenseReport) and an accounting/treasury feature, not the expense report itself.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Documents API listing by element for modulepart expensereport/holiday checks only the module right, with no object or hierarchy check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Generic documents API shared by all modules. It returns file metadata, not the leave record, and other modules there have no object-level check either.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another package (htdocs/api), 1 file away from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Web AJAX mileage computation calls restrictedArea with an ID only, so the hierarchy test is skipped for any fk_expense.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Web UI helper, not the REST API, and it returns only a computed mileage amount.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Relax index() from readall to read plus a user_ids filter (the TODO at line 116 asks for this) without checking that every ID is in childids.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The maintainer's own TODO describes exactly this relaxation. Implementing it naively reintroduces the hierarchy gap through a filter parameter (how-type: identity in a list param).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: put() lets fk_validator be reassigned after the check. Since the check grants access when fk_validator is in childids (htdocs/core/lib/security.lib.php:1256), a planted update of fk_user would be a change-after-check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The generic field-copy loop already assigns any property, and Holiday::update persists fk_validator (htdocs/holiday/class/holiday.class.php:1064).

O9_family: improper authorization: missing hierarchy/ownership (IDOR-style) check in REST API
